narrationTexts: Confirms only "order totals" suite fails, as expected.
Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Fixing it.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only 3 of 625 cases caught it, all with both a discount and a tax rate.

Fix: tax now computed on `discounted`, not `cents`.

Next: nothing.
